messages:
nina: first day, hi! MDM enrollment keeps failing but also my MBA goes into a boot loop when i unplug the USB-C dock. boot loop happens after mac wakes from lid close. FileVault reported "Encryption paused" earlier. anyone run into dock-related hangs? :wave:

it-team: welcome nina! what's the exact model and OS? boot loop on disconnect could be a kernel extension or external disk causing disk arbitration problems. don't create admin. can you confirm if the dock has an attached USB storage device or network drive?

nina: MacBook Air M2, macOS 14.2. dock is a third-party USB-C hub with an external SSD formatted APFS. i do use it for Time Machine occasionally. MDM enrollment showed "Awaiting user approval" earlier but didn't show profile.

sam: hi nina, i'm the onboarding buddy. if the external drive is mounted it can pause encryption. also older hub firmwares cause wake issues. try temporarily unplugging the SSD and then reboot and see if it stops boot looping when unplugged.

nina: unplugged the SSD and rebooted. no more boot loop after a few cycles. ran /usr/sbin/fdesetup status and it reports "Encryption in progress: 12%". profiles status shows none.

it-team: thanks. we prefer to enroll with no external drives to avoid background IO interfering. we'll queue a server-side push for enrollment. i'll also escalate firmware note for devex. mdm-bot: queued enrollment push (job: enroll-1770204321), attempt in 2 minutes.

nina: got a prompt under System Settings > Profiles that says "Redwood Inference". unsure if it's safe — joining a quick share with sam.

sam: confirmed org name on the prompt. approve and enter your password; we'll stay on the call. after approval run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and `sudo /usr/sbin/fdesetup status`.

nina: done. profiles now show "enrolled (user-approved)" and fdesetup says "Encryption in progress: 14%". thanks everyone. will avoid docking the SSD until fully encrypted.

it-team: perfect. we'll monitor and close once encryption completes. welcome again! :tada:
